title: wdm config.toml
description: User settings for wdm. Loaded from ~/.config/wdm/config.toml by internal/state. PRD §34.

schema_version.description: Schema version of this config file. Locked to 1 in v1; future versions trigger migration handled by internal/state.

base_stack_path.description: Base directory under which managed stacks are written. PRD §9. Path safety (symlink resolution, escape prevention) is enforced by internal/security at use time, not by this schema.

timezone.description: IANA timezone name (e.g. 'Europe/Bratislava', 'UTC') or empty string. Empty means: detect from the host at install time. PRD §34.

default_docker_network.description: Default external Docker network attached to managed stacks. Must match Docker's network name rules. PRD §34.

catalog_channel.description: Catalog channel. v1 ships only the public 'stable' channel; 'verified' is reserved for future premium use and is rejected here. PRD §22, §34.

update_check_preference.description: When to check for catalog and binary updates. PRD §34.
